terms.comment: Pliny’s name for the river, which he makes rise in the Rhodope; Lewis & Short has no entry for it. Graesse’s Oesus is a later spelling.

evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Oesus: Oesus, Isker, Nfl. d. Donau (Bulgarien)

sources: The Latin Library texts (thelatinlibrary.com), read in a local copy, for ancient passages not quoted in Lewis & Short; cited by book and section.

J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus, edition of F. Benedict (1909), Latin–German, read in the digitization at columbia.edu (cited as Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v.); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
